glosses: To split or separate (something) into two or more parts.

examples.text: a wall divides two houses; a stream divides the towns

examples.text: Words divide us, Wiktionary unites us.

glosses: To calculate the number (the quotient) by which you must multiply one given number (the divisor) to produce a second given number (the dividend).

examples.text: If you divide 6 by 3, you get 2.

glosses: To be a divisor of.

examples.text: 3 divides 6.
